'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***The remains of three bodies [[Hamas]] gave to [[Israel]] overnight are found to have been of known hostages, leaving eight bodies of deceased hostages still remaining in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/remains-handed-over-israel-not-hostages-israeli-media-report-2025-11-01/ (Reuters)]
**[[Sexual and gender-based violence against Palestinians during the Gaza war]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces]] [[Major General]] [[Yifat Tomer-Yerushalmi]], who served as [[Military Advocate General]], resigns after leaking a surveillance video to the media showing the [[gang rape]] of a [[Palestinians in Israeli custody|Palestinian prisoner]] at [[Sde Teiman detention camp]] in August last year. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyk1dk7d9do (BBC)]
*[[2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
**The [[Pakistan]]i [[Government of Pakistan|government]] partially reopens the [[Torkham border crossing]] with [[Afghanistan]] to allow [[Afghan refugee]]s to flee home, while all remaining restrictions on cross-border movement stay banned, following an agreement to maintain a [[ceasefire]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-afghanistan-torkham-crossing-81b8dad2d70062c5bf4bdcdc5eee9c00 (AP)]
*[[2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers]]
**Three people are killed in an [[United States Navy|American]] [[airstrike]] on a boat in the [[Caribbean Sea]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/2/us-military-kills-three-in-another-strike-on-caribbean-vessel (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**The [[United States]] threatens to carry out attacks in [[Nigeria]] due to continuous attacks against [[Christians]] by [[Boko Haram]] and [[Islamic State – West Africa Province|ISWAP]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/1/trump-threatens-to-launch-attacks-in-nigeria-over-killing-of-christians (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Four people are killed and three injured in an [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] on a vehicle in [[Kfar Reman]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/2/israeli-air-strike-kills-four-in-lebanon-straining-fragile-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**At least 12 people are killed and several others are seriously injured in attacks by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] on two displaced civilian shelters in [[South Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://news.az/news/rsf-paramilitary-attacks-in-south-kordofan-leave-12-civilians-dead (''Azerbaijan'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Grand Egyptian Museum]] in [[Giza]], [[Egypt]], officially opens to the public following long delays. [https://apnews.com/article/egypt-antiquities-museum-pyramids-tutankhamun-1ead2ce683277e613a3aaebb9944d729 (AP)]
*[[Pope Leo XIV]] of the [[Catholic Church]] declares [[John Henry Newman|Saint John Henry Newman]] a [[Doctor of the Church]], one of 38, and a co-[[patron saint|patron]] of [[Catholic school|Catholic education]]. [https://apnews.com/article/vatican-newman-saint-doctor-pope-education-a180cfb0b494119bc5adc5418ef4bb18 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Hermosillo convenience store fire]]
**At least 23 people are killed and eleven others are injured in a fire and explosion at a [[Waldo's]] store in [[Hermosillo]], [[Sonora]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/11/01/americas/mexico-sonora-fire-dozens-killed-intl-hnk (CNN)]
*A [[landslide]] triggered by heavy rain kills at least 21 people and leaves 30 others missing in [[Rift Valley Province]], [[Kenya]]. [https://apnews.com/article/kenya-landslides-elgeyo-marakwet-rift-valley-900f900b8463da42039bc046fcb66013 (AP)]
*A [[crowd crush]] at a [[Hindu temple]] in [[Srikakulam]], [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[India]], kills nine people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indian-temple-stampede-kills-nine-injures-several-2025-11-01/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed and two others are injured in an [[avalanche]] on the [[Vertainspitze]] mountain in the [[Ortler Alps]] in [[South Tyrol]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/11/02/five-german-nationals-killed-avalanche-in-italys-south-tyrol-province (Euronews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Cambridgeshire train stabbing]]
**Eleven people are injured, including nine in life-threatening conditions, in a [[mass stabbing]] attack on a [[London North Eastern Railway]] passenger train in [[Huntingdon]], [[Cambridgeshire]], [[England]]. Two suspects are arrested. [https://news.sky.com/story/huntingdon-train-stabbing-how-the-mass-attack-unfolded-13462334 (Sky News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Carlos Manzo]], mayor of [[Uruapan, Michoacán]], is assassinated during [[Day of the Dead]] festivities. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/nov/02/mexican-mayor-killed-during-day-of-the-dead-celebrations (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Smoking in the Maldives]]
**In the [[Maldives]], people born since 2007 are permanently banned from buying or using [[tobacco]], making it the first country in the world to impose a lifelong [[smoking ban]] from a certain age. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2588826-malediven-eerste-land-ter-wereld-met-generationeel-rookverbod (NOS)]
*Two people are killed and six others are injured, including two suspects, in a [[shootout]] in [[Vorizia, Crete|Vorizia]], [[Crete]], [[Greece]]. [[Hellenic Police|Police]] say that it was caused by a long-standing feud between two local families. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-fatal-shooting-crete-feud-2ff7d19965aa07b4094319131d5afb04 (AP)]
